description: Dose-response point at a later freeze. Base: E116 code. Change only the freeze point of stem + group 1, from 85% to 92% of samples. That point is still inside the 32 px / bs-1024 phase and covers the floor-hold and the final 8-step EMA. Keep every graph and Muon-stack variant as in E116, warmed in build. Before scoring, verify with TORCH_LOGS=recompiles on a 2-trial dev run that nothing recompiles after build. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled 200-trajectory E100 baseline. Add two distinct scored samples with per-trial time logs.
